# Fixtures of godot/private/config/tests

Each section names a fixture and what it reproduces for the tests of this package.

## desktop_runtimes_only

The only runtime components a desktop consumer registers: release slots for Linux and macOS
and no Android or iOS runtime, so a desktop application resolves without mobile toolchains.

## raw_pck

A `.pck` file given where an application expects a start pack.
